image_description: A close-up, slightly soft-focus photograph of a small hamster with brown and white fur. The hamster is positioned in the foreground, facing slightly right, with its head lowered. A second, out-of-focus hamster is visible in the background to the right. The setting appears to be a clean, white surface, possibly a cage or table.

The visible eye is small, round, and dark, matching the diagnostic criteria.
The ears are visible, rounded, and proportionally large relative to the head size, consistent with hamster anatomy.
